messages.author: Rui Saldanha
messages.text: Yuki and Thao are basic fares — the desk will bounce any change request that names them. Six flex fares re-issue for the recorded fees; two new tickets at 320. Standard queue tickets on the 17th of July.

messages.author: Maren Achterberg
messages.text: AP-DK-0105 is standard queue, up to 2,200. The 13 July week is only reachable on the rush queue and that is Rui's approval, not mine.

messages.author: Sun-hee Park
messages.text: For the record my Harborline review on 30 June to 1 July was the other reason the old week was dead for me.
